text.text_excerpt: Absolutely ADORED this place, little hotel to love. Total of 80 rooms. Perfect local in the French Quarter. Enough away that you don't hear the hot mess that is Bourbon St. I read some other reviews that complained about noise...here's the trick. Stay in one of their "Sun Deck" rooms. That way you have a nice buffer between your room and the outside noise. I actually found it to be quiet lovely. I was never bothered with any commotion. The staff, is suuuuuuuuuper friendly and so helpful. Just a note, the front and back of the hotel can be kind of confusing. My daughter and I come to New Orleans every year for the New Orleans Film Festival. We've stayed all over the Quarter; this was our best experience so far. The Bienville is in a great location, easy to get in and out of, convenient to anything you want to do. The staff is super. Special shout out to Cynthia and Beverly at the desk, but everyone was very accommodating. Just one example - I always dread the hassle of checking out of French Quarter hotels, takes forever to get your car and get some help with bags. Not here! When I approached the Bell Captain, he had already noted that I was checking out that day and my car was waiting for me. The room was nice, amenities were plentiful. I en...

I am always skeptical of staying in or close to the French Quarter, but I am so glad I gave this place a try. First of all, this place is just beautiful. The decor inside was updated. The lobby, breakfast area and pool/courtyard area were just quaint and perfect. It is on Decatur street away from most of the hustle and bustle. I didn't have a problem with noise. It is across from the fire department, which was not an issue and it made me feel safer somehow. We got a room on the fourth floor, which is considered their roof.
